message.content: GromHellscream suggests adding lanterns or string lights to brighten the area in the evening, describing it as a "magical" atmosphere that could also be utilized for community gatherings. GromHellscream believes solar-powered lanterns would be the best option as they are eco-friendly and provide a lovely soft glow without the need for wiring. Additionally, he proposes charging the lanterns during the day when working in the garden, ensuring they are ready for evening use.
